badge.content: Product flow // from cue to choice

rows.label: Encounter
rows.them: Open a simulated message or file
rows.us: A safe scenario with fictional details

rows.label: Inspect
rows.them: Review sender, link, context, or file details
rows.us: Clues and prompts to slow the decision down

rows.label: Decide
rows.us: Feedback tied to the choices in that module

rows.label: Continue
rows.them: Return to the guided module path
rows.us: Completion and access progress on the account

rows.label: Contribute
rows.them: Submit or explore a community report
rows.us: Report details, community signals, and notes

rows.label: Review
rows.them: Use the learner profile or admin tools
rows.us: Personal learning record; report and quest controls for admins

closing.content: Alethia is a practice prototype: simulated scenarios, learner progress, and community reporting in one web experience.
